payload.name: pc-contrast-07
payload.description: Raw records must be a list of 1..3 items. Every object has exactly code and enabled. code is a string of length 2..5 inclusive; enabled is an exact bool (False valid). Always result={ok:boolean, records:original if valid else []}. Empty list, missing/null/wrong types, extra fields, and bool-as-int are invalid. No I/O, imports, host calls, or upstream validation assumption. Target inputs interface requires selected-runner support; unapproved draft, not submitted or activated.
